capabilities: Chat with multiple AI agents in one shared conversation
Let agents read, search, create, and edit vault notes with approval gating
Attach vault context via @mentions, folders, tags, and resolved embeds
Search the web during chat via DuckDuckGo, Brave, Tavily, Exa, or SearXNG
Sync and back up chat sessions across devices through WebDAV
extras: Multi-user WebSocket relay chat is explicitly in progress and untested; README documents mobile background-execution limitations (streams pause, tool calls abort) and recommends keeping the app in the foreground for long operations. Requires Obsidian 1.11.4+.
intentEvidence: originally forked from FBarrca/obsidian-inlineAI and has been significantly extended
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI chat, and existing options lack multi-agent conversations, agentic vault tools, and cross-device session sync.

summary: Multi-agent AI chat panel that lets AI profiles use vault context, run note tools, search the web, and sync sessions via WebDAV.
